column1: # TITLE: microRNA microarray on a cohort study of platinum-sensitive versus platinum-resistant NSCLC patients
# SUMMARY: To identify microRNAs that regulate therapeutic resistance
column2: we conducted a high-throughput miRNA microarray on a cohort study of primary NSCLC (non-small cell lung cancer) tissues and adjacent normal tissues. We found some microRNAs related to therapeutic resistance and poor prognosis.
